article.headline: IRGC announces 'inspection regime' on all Hormuz traffic

assignments.reason: Mandatory IRGC inspections on all Hormuz traffic impede free transit and effectively constrain flow without fully sealing the strait.
An inspection regime implies stopping/boarding vessels, creating discrete confrontations and detentions short of a frequent attack pattern.
Unilateral Iranian assertion of control over the strait escalates tensions and narrows, though does not close, the diplomatic off-ramp.

recorded_response.overall_rationale: Iran's unilateral inspection regime is a coercive choke on Hormuz transit that partially constrains the strait and triggers isolated vessel confrontations while raising escalation risk.
